run_timm_training_hpu: run a TIMM model training loop on Intel Gaudi2 HPU devices using the argparse CLI
run_train_one_epoch: run one epoch of training with gradient accumulation, AMP, and EMA model updates
run_validate: run validation on a TIMM model and return loss, top1, and top5 accuracy metrics
run_parse_args: run argument parsing that loads YAML config files and merges with CLI overrides
run_cleanup: run distributed process group cleanup after training completes
